oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT • p99 inference latency spike detected in eu-west (alert-id: A-2345) — pages triggered to oncall rotation. Links: https://ops.redwood/alerts/A-2345 :rotating_light:

Alyssa M: seeing ~6s p99 on text-gen routes since ~22:10 UTC, errors still low but timeouts for some customers. embeddings/kv metrics show increased eviction rate and queue depth on redis-primary-eu1.

Omar K: grabbing logs now. could be prefetch/backpressure issue from new routing rule rolled earlier today. I saw a canary deploy at 20:55 UTC.

Priya S: I'm on CS bridge, notifying top-10 customers in eu region. letting them know we're investigating and may apply temporary throttles.

Dan R: oncall handoff in 30m — I'm primary until 02:00 UTC, Omar is secondary after handoff. Alyssa, can you summarize mitigations in progress?

Alyssa M: current mitigations:
- temporarily increased replica count for model-pool-eu to 6 (was 4) via autoscaler override.
- enabled short-term rate-shedding policy for free-tier routes to reduce load.
- turned on prefix KV caching for high-volume customer prefixes where safe.
- fallback routing enabled to smaller-quantized model for latency-sensitive routes.

oncall-bot: ACTION LOG • replica scale request created by Alyssa (run-id r-9982).

Omar K: putting commands in case you need to run manually:
```
# scale deployment
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/model-pool-eu --replicas=6
# check redis eviction rates
kubectl -n infra exec -it redis-primary-eu1 -- redis-cli INFO stats | grep evicted
```

Priya S: CS note: currently 11 customers reported slow responses, 3 have escalated to account teams. I've assigned a high-priority update to them. Contact: cs-bridge.

Dan R: coverage note for handoff — primary: Dan R (until 02:00 UTC), secondary: Omar K (post-handoff). Out-of-hours escalation: Eng-sre Pager then Eng-Platform on call. No gaps expected but watch eu shift overlap at 23:30 UTC.

Alyssa M: mitigation status: replica scale complete, observed 10% p99 improvement but evictions still elevated. KV prefetch warming in progress. If evictions persist we may need to failover to redis-secondary-eu2 (impact: short cache warmup, small extra latency).

oncall-bot: TIP • runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-evictions — steps for failover and cache-warmup checklist.

Omar K: noticed increased tail latency correlated with batch-size growing to 32 on some requests. I'm rolling a temporary limiter to reduce max batch size to 16 on eu cluster to keep latency controlled.

Alyssa M: command I ran to limit batcher:
```
# update configmap to reduce max_batch_size
kubectl -n inference patch configmap/batcher-config -p '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"16"}}'
# rollout restart batcher pods
kubectl -n inference rollout restart ds/batcher-eu
```

Priya S: CS updated customers at 22:30 UTC: messaging explains degraded latency, mitigation actions, expected follow-ups. Asking product folks for ETA on full clearance.

Dan R: escalation plan if metrics worsen:
1) Failover to redis-secondary-eu2 (prepped by Alyssa), communicate 10-20m warmup.
2) Enforce broader rate-shedding (extend to paid tiers as last resort).
3) If region saturates, enable cross-region routing to eu-central for non-location-restricted traffic.

Alyssa M: prepping failover steps now and will handoff the checklist to Omar. Current temp ETA for stabilization: 15-30m.

Omar K: noted. I'll take over operations during handoff. Will monitor p99, kv_evictions, embeddings queue, and autoscales. Also will watch the canary cluster for the 21:10 deploy artifact.

oncall-bot: NOTE • incident severity remains P2 (customer impact limited to some responses degraded). Update required every 30m.

Priya S: CS will send another customer update at 23:00 UTC. I've added a link to the public status page: https://status.redwood/ongoing-incidents/A-2345

Dan R: handoff checklist before I leave:
- confirm replica scale and batcher patch completed (Alyssa)
- confirm CS updates scheduled (Priya)
- ensure secondary (Omar) has runbook links and credentials
- sticky note: contact cloud-noc if cross-region failover needed

Alyssa M: all done, left a snippet for Omar in ops-notes: "failover-prep: redis-secondary-eu2 warmed, snapshot at 22:25 UTC, replicate offset 42s".

Omar K: thanks — picking this up. Monitoring dashboard pinned: https://dash.redwood/p/eu-inference-tail 

Priya S: added timeline to incident doc and CS post. participants: Alyssa (ops), Omar (secondary), Dan (primary), Priya (cs).

Dan R: leaving now, handoff complete. Omar, you're primary. If anything changes ping me on mobile. :iphone:

Omar K: acknowledged. I'll post updates here every 15m or on faster cadence if something changes. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: THREAD CLOSED BY HANDOFF • handoff-ts: 3897654610 — primary changed to Omar K. Reminder: update incident doc and set next update in 30m.
